authority: user, 2026-10-17: the 30 GPU-hour budget no longer constrains design; G0 strengthened; OCC-P1 widened to seeds 4201-4207; G0 pass allows OCC-P1 to follow without a further approval; OCC-P2 and planner work need their own preregistration
purpose: measure how often and how long a once-acquired target is geometrically occluded by bars, by obstacle density and target motion; exploratory even with seven seeds (no confirmatory label; OCC-P2 with fresh seeds is the confirmatory step)
analysis: tools/occlusion_analysis.py pilot; Kaplan-Meier with its independent-censoring caveat plus Aalen-Johansen cumulative incidence by end cause; rates per post-acquisition exposure second; episode-cluster bootstrap and per-seed values
geometry_only: tools/occlusion_analysis.py sweep over the pilot's recorded layouts, three scripted families (static_pursuit, static_crossing, moving_pursuit at 1.5 m/s), collisions ignored, labelled GEOMETRY_ONLY_KINEMATIC_BASELINE and reported apart from the whole-system pilot. Straight pursuit of a static target cannot re-occlude after a clear sight line, so static post-acquisition occlusion in the pilot can only come from detours or lateral motion

safety.disk_rule: refuse to start and stop before the next cell below 8 GB free
safety.overrun_rule: a cell slower than overrun_factor x expected is recorded with its ratio, outcome counts and disk state; the run continues unless the wall-clock cap is hit
safety.integrity: every historical cell re-verified against its RAW_MANIFEST before launch; Policy F SHA-256 checked before and after; new run ids; existing results never overwritten
safety.external_backup: NOT_COMPLETED; recorded, not a blocking condition for this run

g0.design: each (group, density) runs twice on the same commit: OFF = recorder + trajectory digest + actor-observation dump, no telemetry; ON = the same plus the telemetry variables. Both runs are compared, and ON is also compared with the historical cell
noninterference_checks: result.json equal except the run nonce
trajectory digest sha256 and step count equal, steps > 0
every actor-observation row sampled by both runs bitwise equal (observation_gate, unmodified helper)
recorder episode records equal field by field
ON equals the historical cell on the first four episodes per environment (ledger fields)

renderer_parity_checks.needs: probe frames present and render alignment ZERO_LATENCY_RENDER_DELIVERY; otherwise NOT_TESTED

g0.scene_confirmation: counts of frames that are visible (in view, clear, rendered pixels > 0), partial (centre blocked, rim not all blocked or pixels > 0) and full (geometric full proxy, and rendered zero pixels when the probe ran); at least one of each among the ON cells, with episode keys
g0.timestamp_rule: when render alignment is not verified, camera-versus-geometry comparisons are UNKNOWN and rendered_full_in_view stays NOT_RECORDED
g0.pass: noninterference PASS on all 8 pairs AND parity PASS or NOT_TESTED-with-reason AND scenes PRESENT; a noninterference failure blocks OCC-P1

pilot.requires: g0 report at the same commit with noninterference PASS

g0_noninterference.rule: per cell, the first 4 episodes of every environment equal the historical cell: ledger fields exactly and every recorder field present in both
g0_noninterference.on_mismatch: stop the run at that cell, keep everything, report the differing fields; no identity claim
g0_noninterference.scope: telemetry on versus historical telemetry off, different source commits with identical simulation code paths; a mismatch alone does not say which difference caused it

reporting: geometric occlusion share of acquired episodes and rate per observation second
duration distribution and KM at 0.5/1/2/3 s, 5 s secondary with risk-set size
cumulative incidence by end cause (restored / capture / crash / timeout)
fused loss reported separately and never called occlusion
exposure time per density (what crash and capture leave to observe)
GPU seconds and output bytes per cell
